utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Dane — I’m ready to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to take on?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — could you handle collecting the tool donations and checking in with folks who already promised parts?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll start collecting the tool donations and follow up with everyone who promised parts.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Leo — could you check exactly what parts and tools we still need, and whether the drive is already powered down?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll check the parts and tools list, and I’ll make sure the drive is powered down before we touch anything.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can check what supplies we already have and make a quick list of what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, that sounds great — I might’ve missed what we already have, so a quick list would really help.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ll check the supplies and send you a quick list of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That’s kind of you—I'm still trying to sort out who needs which supplies and who can bring them over. If you can help me keep track of the list, that’d make things a lot easier.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can do that—send me the list and I’ll keep track of who needs what and who’s bringing it over.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Nell, what time is the repair drive starting, and do you need any help setting up?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m not sure yet—I just heard it’s starting later today. If you’re around, I’d really appreciate any help setting up.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’m around and can help. Just text me when you know the time.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a pretty good turnout already — folks seem eager to help. I’ll keep you posted if I hear anything else.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: That’s great to hear. If they need an extra hand or any tools, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Will do — that’s really kind of you. I’ll let you know if they call for extra hands or tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away. Want me to invite folks over for Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, Saturday works well—please invite everyone to the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: You got it — I’ll let everyone know and make sure they hear about Saturday. See you then!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Happy to help with the repair drive, Kira—what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Thanks, Sam—just to confirm, are you definitely available to help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m definitely available to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I’m putting together the repair drive details now. If you’ve got any homes or supplies to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’ll send you any homes or supplies I hear about.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Bo — I appreciate it. I’ll keep everything organized and share the update once I’ve got the list together.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll mention it to the others and keep the repair drive plan moving.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Vik. Let me know the plan once you’ve heard back, and I’ll keep my part ready.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Will do — I’ll ask around and come back with the plan as soon as I hear back.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m ready to help, I just need the details again.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. I’ll bring the details by later today; I just need a little time to sort them out.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: No rush at all, Uli—I’ll be here when you’re ready. Just bring me whatever you’ve got, and I’ll do my best to help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help keep folks in the loop about the repair drive—what’s the latest we need to coordinate?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll swing by the hardware store and check what supplies they can donate, then I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Ira — that’s a huge help. I’ll wait for your update and then I can pass it along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, the repair drive’s getting started soon — want me to put your name down?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, go ahead and put me down — I’ll likely join a bit late, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you on the list. Swing by whenever you can; we’ll be glad to see you.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I haven’t heard the details yet, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Rey. I’ll write up a simple list of what needs fixing and when we’re meeting, then I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Eli. Bring it by whenever you’re ready, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help line up the school pickup times around the repair drive. What time are they planning to start?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Faye — they’re aiming to start around 9 a.m., and I’ll confirm if that shifts.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That works — I’ll plan pickup around 9 and keep an eye out for any changes.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help connect folks for the repair drive—what do you need me to line up?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Could you line up a few volunteers and maybe a couple of tool donations for the repair drive? I’ll keep track of who’s bringing what.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll reach out to a few neighbors for volunteers and see if anyone can lend tools too. I’ll send you names and what they can bring once I’ve got responses.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure, Pia — I can lend a hand, and I’ve got a few tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus. That helps a lot — I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the right tools and not too many extra trips.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Of course — I can bring a tape measure, screwdrivers, and my drill, and we can see what else we actually need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping an eye on the repair drive locations, Rosa. Tell me which spot you want me to check next.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Opal — could you check the community center next? If that’s clear, please let me know what tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’ll check the community center and report back on any tools they still need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so. Let me just check the details before I confirm for sure.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — what time should we meet, and where should I bring the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — could you check what repair supplies we already have and what’s still missing?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’ll check what we’ve got and make a list of what’s missing.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s happening soon, but I’m still piecing together the details. If you know where people should drop things off, I’d really appreciate the update.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, I might’ve missed the latest on that too. I think they’re collecting stuff near the community center, but I’d double-check with someone organizing it.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that helps—I’ll check with the organizers to be sure. If I hear the exact drop-off time, I’ll pass it along.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Repair drive, right? Just confirming—when is it happening and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, the repair drive is this Saturday morning at the community center. If you can, bring gloves, a few tools, and maybe a box or two for donations.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it—Saturday morning at the community center. I’ll see if I can bring gloves, a few tools, and a box or two.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything useful about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate you keeping an ear out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Of course — I’ll check in with a few folks and come back if I hear any updates.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m still a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Oren — we’re just collecting broken small appliances and tools for the repair drive. If you can help sort or carry items, that’d be great.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Sure thing, Leo — I can help sort and carry the items. Just point me to where you want me.
